bundle.shortDescription: Desktop translation tool for RPG Maker games
bundle.longDescription: FairTranslator is a desktop application for translating RPG Maker MZ, MV, VX Ace, VX, and XP games. It supports manual editing, glossary-based workflows, built-in providers such as OpenAI, DeepL, Google Translate, and Codex, plus structured external AI batch flows. Commercial releases are intended for direct-license distribution without mandatory subscriptions.
